job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

THE ROLE

You are the builder. You take the vision from the Head of AI and make it real connecting Ethoss data systems to AI, building automation pipelines, and creating the infrastructure that makes every department smarter. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast with prototypes, and relentless about reliability. When something is built, it works. Every time.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Build and maintain the Dynamic ERP to Claude API data pipeline
Develop automation workflows using Make.com, Zapier, and custom Python scripts
Integrate Google Ads, GA4, and CRM data into the central AI intelligence system
Build the WhatsApp Business API delivery layer for automated briefs and alerts
Develop the internal dashboard for department-level AI querying
Implement third-party AI plugins Klevu, Klaviyo, Insider, Yotpo on ethoswatches.com
Maintain API connections, monitor data quality, and ensure pipeline reliability
Document all systems and train department teams on usage

WHO YOU ARE

3 5 years of software engineering experience with a focus on data pipelines and integrations
Strong Python skills APIs, data processing, automation scripting
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Claude or OpenAI preferred)
Comfortable with Make.com or Zapier for no-code/low-code automation
Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and cloud infrastructure
Has built and maintained production-grade systems not just prototypes
Self-directed and comfortable working in a small, high-accountability team


Disclaimer : This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
